owner_instruction_verbatim: launch 6 agents for each track ( so we are attacking 18 problems at 1 time )
supersedes: contract-v1.json's three-agent concurrency/ownership counts only. Its preservation, deadline, scientific admission, source and verification requirements remain unless expressly clarified here. The two parent errata remain mandatory.
deadline_rule: Expansion within the existing 96-hour round; no new 96-hour clock or reset of consumed time.

concurrency.counting: Each worker owns ONE distinct active scientific problem. Peer-review copies, corollaries and alternate encodings of the same target are not extra problem slots. Parent owns integration, not an additional counted problem. Actual launch/ACK evidence must precede a claim of full startup.
concurrency.provider_limits: No account/model/config changes, paid API fallback or rate-limit bypass. Any real scheduling/quota limit must be reported rather than pretending queued jobs are simultaneously working.

ownership.new_slot_roots: Each roster entry below owns only its write_root. All other slot roots and all shared indexes are read-only.
ownership.legacy_cutover: The three retained agents finish any currently assigned review safely and report it; new primary work moves into their designated parallel-18 slot roots. Existing round-level files become immutable baselines. New workers never edit those baselines. No physical evidence move or deletion is authorized.
ownership.corrections: Exclusive new files; frozen corrections via numbered versions/addenda. No edits to sibling files, generated historical engine records or unrelated user work.

initial_work: All eighteen may read sources, extract source pages, freeze exact claims and perform written research concurrently. A target is an investigation assignment, not a certificate that the literature still calls it open. Each new worker must read its actual current baseline and run the primary-source/corpus screen before claiming a new result.

execution.named_GO_required: Any scientific script, solver, compilation, enumeration or executable certificate replay requires an exact source/input-pinned parent admission, controls, resources, deadline and graceful settlement. This includes parent scientific programs; metadata/source extraction is separate.
execution.aggregate_ceiling_not_expanded: At most12 scientific CPU threads and24GiB aggregate RAM after individual admission; the eighteen-agent instruction does not authorize eighteen native searches. At most4threads/8GiB per admitted problem, no GPU/remote compute. Fresh resource observations required.
execution.existing_worker_assay: The old physics-gs4-exact-001 GO is consumed and does not authorize any of these workers to rerun it.
execution.other_prohibitions: No paid fallback, account rotation, config mutation, Git commit/push, publication, external contact, deletion, old held runtime restart, cron or launchd. Existing environments read-only.

selection_and_replacement.freeze: Each slot writes startup-v1.json and selection-v1.md identifying the exact problem, book/source relationship, current primary baseline, literal quantifiers, desired consequential delta, first bounded attack, verification route and redirect condition. Retained agents may reference their current selection but must bind it in the new slot.
selection_and_replacement.scope: Solve the stated target or explicitly mark the achieved subclaim as partial. Never silently replace unrestricted objects by a convenient ansatz. Rewording a known restriction or duplicating an existing certificate is not progress.
selection_and_replacement.source_gate: Read primary theorem statements and relevant definitions. Search misses are not openness/novelty proof. Math-related targets require local/remote openai/math screening. Prior papers can be unrefereed claims without being ignored or accepted automatically.
selection_and_replacement.replacement: If a matched primary source already settles a target or no justified new input remains, report it immediately and freeze a distinct replacement in the SAME worker. Parent must check that it is not in the roster or another slot's live work. Never count a solved target or an idle screening dossier as an ongoing unsolved attack.
selection_and_replacement.no_review_only_slots: All six entries per domain are problem owners. Peer review may be temporarily exchanged, but a reviewer is not counted as a separate scientific problem.

verification.levels: CANDIDATE, actual in-harness written checks, finite evidence, formal proof and novelty are separate. Python arithmetic is not a proof-assistant kernel. Finite point tests do not prove symbolic identities. Different agents need not be different model families or blind reviewers. No aggregate theorem/discovery counts.
verification.reviews: Complete candidates need parent and an actual separate reconstruction at the pinned snapshot. No automatic outside-model CLI reviews are authorized. No build/lint/test/formatter suites mid-flight; narrowly proposed scientific checks need admission, consolidated verification follows a complete candidate.
verification.sources_and_imports: State exact classical imports and inaccessible sources. No human review, kernel acceptance, novelty clearance or solved-book claim without its own evidence.

checkpoints: Real startup ACK plus artifact; then at most30minutes between substantive active checkpoints (actual result, exact blocker, next bounded action). Observe date immediately before timestamping; never estimate a time and call it observed. A parked worker reports PARKED, not continuous work.
